task.title: Weekly plan view: week grid of lunch and dinner slots backed by recipes
task.description: First slice of the Weekly Meal Planner build, per the owner decisions recorded in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-18-weekly-meal-planner-as-built-spec.md (section 'Owner decisions'). Scope: the Plan view only: week navigation, seven days of lunch and dinner slots, the four slot types, keyboard-first capture, Cook meals pointing at recipes, Eat out and other-leftovers meals as small records, leftovers pointing at an earlier slot, planner preferences (week start, people). Household-ready data shape. Not in this slice: the weekly grocery list, nutrition, AI helpers.
